QuestInfo.name: That Was Truly Wretched
QuestInfo.0: You run into Triple Volt at the entrance to Kerning Square. Looks like they're up to no good...
QuestInfo.1: Vicky, a Triple Volt member, comes to Kerning Square to participate in a singing audition. Vicky is excited but loses her ticket! You decide to help, hoping you can get Vicky to share some information on the Spirit of Rock. Hunt some Cherry Bubble Teas and get Vicky 40 Audition Scratch Cards.
QuestInfo.2: You didn't find any winning tickets in any of your Cherry Bubble Teas.

0.1: Waaaaiiit!! Don't attack us! I'm sorry about last time!
0.2: Now, now... Just calm down! We can wipe the slate clean, have a fresh start!
0.3: So, what are you doing here? Are you here for the audition, too?
0.4: Oh, you came to get the Spirit of Rock too?
0.5: Really? We have some business with him too. Why don't we make a deal? You scratch our back and we'll scratch yours.

yes.0: We're here for the audition at Kerning Square.
